clash:
mixed-port: 7890
allow-lan: true
mode: rule
log-level: info
ipv6: false
proxies:
    - name: US · hysteria2
      type: hysteria2
      server: destination.example
      port: 443
      password: secret
      sni: tls.example
      alpn:
        - h3
    - name: US · hysteria2 · 经 HK
      type: hysteria2
      server: 203.0.113.1
      port: 31000
      password: secret
      sni: tls.example
      alpn:
        - h3
proxy-groups:
    - name: PROXY
      type: select
      proxies:
        - AUTO
        - FALLBACK
        - US · hysteria2
        - US · hysteria2 · 经 HK
        - DIRECT
    - name: AUTO
      type: url-test
      proxies:
        - US · hysteria2
        - US · hysteria2 · 经 HK
      url: http://www.gstatic.com/generate_204
      interval: 300
    - name: FALLBACK
      type: fallback
      proxies:
        - US · hysteria2
        - US · hysteria2 · 经 HK
      url: http://www.gstatic.com/generate_204
      interval: 300
    - name: DOMESTIC
      type: select
      proxies:
        - DIRECT
        - PROXY
    - name: ADBLOCK
      type: select
      proxies:
        - REJECT
        - DIRECT
rules:
    - IP-CIDR,127.0.0.0/8,DIRECT,no-resolve
    - IP-CIDR,192.168.0.0/16,DIRECT,no-resolve
    - IP-CIDR,10.0.0.0/8,DIRECT,no-resolve
    - DOMAIN-KEYWORD,google,PROXY
    - DOMAIN-KEYWORD,github,PROXY
    - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,openai.com,PROXY
    - GEOIP,CN,DIRECT
    - MATCH,PROXY
